subject: Request to include security + procurement — need to shift demo slot

Cc: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo - Redwood Inference Platform (Fri 3/26)

Thanks Vivek — excited to see the platform. Quick update from intake: our security and procurement teams want to be present for the session and they need to review some compliance artifacts before we sign off. Also, our Head of Platform (Evan Li) has an out-of-office travel commitment on 3/26 and won't be available that day.

That means the original 3/26 slot won't work for a full stakeholder run-through. Can we look at rescheduling next week? Our best windows (PST) are: Tue 3/30 from 10:00–12:00 or Thu 4/1 after 13:00. Prefer Tue 3/30 if possible.

I'll loop in Security and Procurement separately—Natalie can confirm their attendees. I've attached the intake form we ran internally so you can see questions they'll ask.

Thanks,
James Park
Senior PM, Aurelia Health
james.park@aureliahealth.com

James — thanks for the heads up and for the intake form. Appreciate the clarity on stakeholders.

We can absolutely accommodate Security and Procurement. Proposed approach:
- Move the main demo to Tue 3/30 10:00–11:00 PST (we'll keep it to 60 minutes and focus the first 20 minutes on architecture/security + procurement questions)
- Offer an optional 30-min pre-brief on Tue 3/30 09:30–10:00 for your Security and Procurement SMEs to cover any redlines/quick evidence requests before the main session

Marissa / Neha / Karthik — can you confirm availability for the 09:30 pre-brief + 10:00 demo on 3/30? Also I'll attach our MAP and a short security-runbook outline for their review.

If 3/30 doesn't work for any of your stakeholders, Thu 4/1 after 13:00 PST is our second choice.

I'll hold both windows tentatively.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

People from our side: Vivek (AE), Marissa (Solutions), Neha (CS), Karthik (Platform), Soojin (Security).

Please send the invite with confirmed attendees or reply with any conflicts. Linking the tentative calendar invite here so you can accept: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-aurelia-3-30

Best,
Vivek
